experiment_data.hypothesis: Full M2 Qwen: 3 strategies (random/embedding/dataflow) × 3 seeds on full M1 data (~11K train/seed). Statistical validation of pilot signal (embedding > random +2pp). Go/no-go for paper claims per D018.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/structfuse && bash run_m2_full_qwen.sh"

experiment_data.notes: Full M2 go/no-go: 3 strategies (random, embedding_distance, dataflow_aware) × 3 seeds (42, 43, 44) = 9 runs sequential on cuda:0. Config: lr=2e-5, epochs=3, batch_size=8, eval_steps=500, num_negatives=7, max_seq_length=2048, warmup_ratio=0.1, weight_decay=0.01, temperature=0.07, LoRA r=16, gradient_checkpointing=True, proj_dim=256. Dual checkpoint: best_by_val_loss + best_by_recall_at_1. Train ~11.3K/seed, val ~3K/seed.
